governance_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-B - Owner Decision Package & Governance Checklist

DEC-01.title: Select Future Market-Data Provider
DEC-01.recommended_default: Option A (Tiingo Starter/Power) for simplicity and robust split/dividend adjustments, OR Option C (Alpaca) if paper broker order mock is prioritized.
DEC-01.evidence: v30_stage2h_b_provider_rights_matrix.json confirms personal non-commercial licenses permit private algorithmic modeling.
DEC-01.unresolved_conditions: Owner must select one provider and enter their own personal subscription credentials. No credentials currently exist in workspace.
DEC-01.risks: Third-party API downtime, rate limiting, or potential exchange policy changes.
DEC-01.reversibility: HIGH: Provider adapter is fully decoupled via provider-neutral interface.
DEC-01.exact_owner_action: Owner reviews provider terms, selects provider, and registers personal non-professional account.

DEC-02.title: Verify Exact License, Storage, and Research Rights

supported_options.name: Personal Non-Professional Research License (Local Cache Only)
supported_options.description: Strict single-user private modeling. No external dashboard or redistribution.

supported_options.name: Commercial Redistribution License
supported_options.description: Required if model outputs or quotes are ever broadcast externally.

DEC-02.recommended_default: Option A (Personal Non-Professional License), as Guardian Alpha is private proprietary research.
DEC-02.evidence: Contractual due diligence in Gate B confirms personal plans forbid redistribution but permit private model evaluation.
DEC-02.unresolved_conditions: Owner must confirm they qualify as Non-Professional under NYSE/NASDAQ/CTA definitions.
DEC-02.risks: Exchange audit reclassification if account is operated on behalf of an investment fund.
DEC-02.reversibility: HIGH: Upgradable to commercial tier at any time.
DEC-02.exact_owner_action: Owner signs non-professional subscriber declaration during data vendor registration.

DEC-03.title: Approve Paired Primary Endpoint & Return Trade-off

supported_options.name: Standard Paired Downside Shortfall (theta_def > 0) with -200 bps CAGR Margin
supported_options.description: Preregistered primary test: D2 must reduce downside shortfall on defensive days without lagging E0 annual CAGR by > 2.0%.

supported_options.name: Strict Zero Return Drag Tolerance (0 bps)
supported_options.description: Requires D2 to match or beat E0 in all market environments.

DEC-03.recommended_default: Option A: Statistically well-formulated and reflects realistic insurance premium trade-off.
DEC-03.unresolved_conditions: Owner must formally approve the 200 bps annual insurance cost budget.
DEC-03.risks: In strong bull markets, cash drag of D2 may exceed 200 bps.
DEC-03.reversibility: LOW: Endpoint cannot be altered after prospective evaluation begins without invalidating preregistration.
DEC-03.exact_owner_action: Owner approves theta_def formula and 200 bps budget before prospective evaluation launch.

DEC-04.title: Approve Evaluation Horizon, Minimum Defensive Sample, & Stopping Policy

supported_options.name: 252 Trading Sessions Horizon with Minimum N_def = 30 Sessions
supported_options.description: If N_def < 30 at T=252, extend evaluation until N_def reaches 30 (or max 504 sessions).

supported_options.name: Fixed 504 Sessions (2-Year Horizon)
supported_options.description: Higher statistical power (80% MDE = 32 bps), but delays decision.

DEC-04.recommended_default: Option A: Balanced duration with rigorous contingent extension safeguard.
DEC-04.evidence: Power and MDE calculations in Gate C showing N=30 is minimal floor; N>=45 provides superior precision.
DEC-04.unresolved_conditions: Owner confirmation of willing waiting period (1 calendar year).
DEC-04.risks: Prolonged low-volatility bull market may yield few defensive days.
DEC-04.reversibility: MEDIUM: Horizon extensions must be planned in advance to avoid p-hacking.
DEC-04.exact_owner_action: Owner approves 252-session horizon with N_def >= 30 contingent extension.

DEC-05.title: Approve Monitoring, Incident Response, & Evidence Retention

supported_options.name: Hardened 4-Tier Severity Playbook with Persistent Disk Hard-Stop
supported_options.description: INFORMATIONAL, WARNING, CRITICAL, HARD STOP. Persistent lock survives process restarts.

DEC-05.recommended_default: Option A: Critical for operational safety and auditability.
DEC-05.evidence: Gate G specification and v30_stage2h_b_security_guard.py persistent lock implementation.
DEC-05.unresolved_conditions: Owner review of manual reset key requirement.
DEC-05.risks: Hard-stop requires owner manual action to clear after severe incidents.
DEC-05.reversibility: HIGH: Playbook thresholds can be tuned prior to activation.
DEC-05.exact_owner_action: Owner reviews and ratifies incident severity taxonomy and persistent lock policy.

DEC-06.title: Separately Authorize Paper-Only Prospective Activation

supported_options.name: Authorize Paper-Only Evaluation (Zero Live Orders)
supported_options.description: Requires explicit signed owner token. Engine executes strictly in paper simulation.

supported_options.name: Maintain Current Frozen Research State (No Activation)

DEC-06.recommended_default: Option B until DEC-01 through DEC-05 are resolved by the owner.
DEC-06.evidence: All architectural, accounting, and security prerequisites are satisfied; activation is blocked purely by lack of human authorization.
DEC-06.unresolved_conditions: Requires human owner signature and token generation. NO TOKEN GENERATED IN THIS STAGE.
DEC-06.risks: Premature activation before provider and endpoint decisions are locked.
DEC-06.reversibility: HIGH: Paper evaluation can be halted instantly without financial capital risk.
DEC-06.exact_owner_action: Owner generates signed HMAC authorization token when ready to begin prospective evaluation.
